items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 3: NC State dropped ball
items.description: The Wolfpack's inexplicable loss resulted in a very predictable appearance on our dubious list.

items.headline: Georgia State hosts Northern Illinois in Week 4
items.description: Northern Illinois (0-3) at Georgia State (2-1), Sept. 26 at 2 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Noah Fifita breaks Arizona's all-time passing mark, Wildcats roll over Northern Illinois 42-17
items.description: — Arizona coach Brent Brennan was not going to let Noah Fifita miss a chance to break the school’s all-time passing mark at home.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 2: Oregon ducks onto list
items.description: Strange happenings continue in college football, where long losing streaks have become a winning formula.

items.headline: Arizona hosts Northern Illinois in Week 3
items.description: Northern Illinois (0-2) at Arizona (1-1), Sept. 19 at 10:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Roy throws late TD pass, lifts FCS-member Illinois State past Northern Illinois 28-24
items.description: — Gage Roy threw a 16-yard touchdown pass to Alex Herrera with 1:53 remaining, and FCS-member Illinois State beat Northern Illinois 28-24 on Saturday night.
